channel.description: News, development updates and playtest info for STATIC: Salvage vs Hunter.

item.title: Why sound is your only weapon
item.description: STATIC does not use sound for jump scares — it uses noise as the game economy. How mistake-driven noise, siphon pod alarms, and drag audio make every action a bet.

item.title: What is STATIC? Roblox horror, explained
item.description: A plain-English guide to STATIC, the 5v1 Roblox horror game: how a match works, what the Hunter can and cannot do, and why every round ends differently.

item.title: Why we deleted the radar
item.description: The Hunter used to have a server-side radar. It was the most technically honest feature in the game — and we cut it anyway. Here is the design math that killed it.

item.title: Asymmetrical Horror: Hunter vs 5 Scrappers
item.description: What asymmetrical horror actually means, and how STATIC builds it: 5 Scrappers, 1 Hunter, no radar for anyone, and rounds decided by mistakes.

item.title: Why Roblox Is the Best Engine for Solo Devs
item.description: Discover why we chose Roblox for STATIC. Learn the best way to market an indie game by leveraging platform discovery to grow your community fast.

item.title: Scary Roblox Games to Play With Friends (2026 Shortlist)
item.description: Five scary Roblox games worth playing with friends this year, tested with a real squad - plus the free 5v1 game we are building.

item.title: Best Roblox Horror Games 2026: What We'd Actually Play
item.description: Our honest 2026 shortlist of the best Roblox horror games, ranked by what makes horror work - by the team building one of them.

item.title: Roblox Horror Games With Voice Chat: What VC Changes
item.description: How proximity voice chat rewires Roblox horror - what it fixes, what it breaks, and games that use it well, from a VC-first horror dev.
